name: NM4 hall, Fermilab

coordinates.note: No source fetched this session gives a surveyed lat/lon for the NM4 building specifically. Following the same honest pattern already used for site:fermilab-main-campus (owned by another workstream) and site:cern-ecn3-north-area (this workstream), the campus-level OSM/Nominatim centroid for the whole Fermilab site is recorded here with a large precision_m and `confidence: uncertain`. Treat this as campus precision, not hall precision.

summary.plain: The Fermilab hall used by the SeaQuest Drell-Yan experiment, and proposed as the home of its DarkQuest successor.
summary.technical: NM4 Building on the Fermilab fixed-target beamlines (Batavia, Illinois), housing the SeaQuest/E906 dimuon spectrometer on the 120 GeV Main Injector proton beam; proposed site of the DarkQuest dark-sector upgrade. No surveyed coordinate for this specific hall was found, so the Fermilab campus point is used at reduced precision.

notes: facility:fermilab is owned by the fermilab-dune workstream; this record only references it.
Coordinates reuse the same honestly-approximate Fermilab campus point as site:fermilab-main-campus rather than duplicating a fresh geocoder lookup; see coordinates.note.
